title: NLP for youth mental health
summary: Use NLP models and causal methods to understand how adolescents' emotional and social states evolve over time, and which factors genuinely drive risk.

title: Making topic models more usable for real analysts
summary: Extend my previous work on topic models and evaluation: desgining algorithms for the automatic corpus preparation, interactive interfaces for exploring topics, or workflows that let human experts iteratively refine models instead of treating them as black boxes.

title: NLP pipelines for scientific & policy intelligence
summary: Build tools that help analysts navigate scientific publications and policy-relevant documents: contradiction detection, evolution of themes in a field, or detecting emerging areas and risks.
